files.description: Project conventions: architecture, strict typing, docstring format, TDD, environment variables, and key design decisions
Review priorities, repository invariants, evidence bar, severity, and what not to comment on
Session replay model and public surface: discovery, signed URLs, fetch and analysis (Workspace replay methods, Replay and ReplayBundle types, mp replays), rrweb analysis, labels
Query contracts shared by insights, funnels, retention, flows, and user queries: the Workspace.query_* methods, their parameter and result types, the bookmark builders and validation, and mp query
Report link semantics: URL parse and build, project and workspace scope, the Workspace report-link methods, ReportLink types, and mp reports
Library code: errors and broad catches, frozen and mutable models, bool versus int, public-surface sync
CLI: no API client in CLI modules, output through formatters, option dependencies, exit codes
Test conventions: docstrings, tests that can fail, isolation from real ~/.mp and MP_* variables, no live network, live tests
Conformance corpus: generated vectors and contract, rrweb goldens that follow the analyzer, hand-written tooling, stamp checks
Session replay analyzer: what to review, golden regeneration, module conventions
Design specs: what to check across the files of one feature
Claude Code plugin: mp help instead of copied reference, plugin venv paths, error handling in examples, stderr
Docs and changelog: match the code, Unreleased section, plain-language reasons, fenced examples
GitHub Actions: SHA pins, least permissions, label-gated API keys, Copilot setup steps
